Mod.Name: [Tsunamods] Cosmo Memory
Mod.Description: Complete sound overhaul. -Updates every single sound effect in the game. -Adds ambient sound effects to every field in the game. -Adds ambient sound effects to every battle in the game. -Voiced attacks for every character. -Ground-conditional footstep sounds. -Updates all video cutscene sound effects. -Shuffles sounds so repeating sounds don't sound the same. -3 selectable menu sound sets.
